## Finding

**Verdict:** likely_vacant (0.92 confidence).

Oakland's 2019 planning notice explicitly describes APN 003 007101400 at 623 15TH STREET as a vacant parcel. A 2022 land listing for the same parcel reports no improvements assessment, and 2026 commercial marketing again offers it as a development site. Taken together, these support that the parcel is vacant now and has been vacant since at least 2019-08-02. The vacancy start date is unknown; the duration is a minimum supported interval of 7 years, 2 months, 13 days as of 2026-10-15. This does not establish continuous vacancy from an earlier date or substitute for an on-site check.

The issue says ZIP 94612, while Oakland's 2019 notice and the listings identify 94606; APN and street address match.
